page.notes: Margin note "Quæst. XXIX." is printed in the left margin beside the first line. Doubtful readings: "erucre" (possibly a misprint for "eruere"); "lui" (possibly "sui"); the Hebrew word after "&" (עשׂה, vowel points unclear); the Greek "ποιεῖν" after "τὸ"; "Pontificus" as printed. Last line of the page is hyphenated ("demon-") and continues on the next page; the catchword "strationes" is printed at the lower right. The Greek and Hebrew are transcribed in their own letters. Light stains and show-through from the reverse side are not transcribed.
